title: Accounting database daemon goes down
teaches: Scheduling continues without slurmdbd; slurmctld queues the records and replays them. Anything that reads accounting (sacct, triage evidence) goes blind meanwhile.

got.summary: Accounting (slurmdbd) is unreachable. Scheduling continues and slurmctld queues job records until it's back; meanwhile triage can't check job history or node events.
